mil3.7.9:0.3: Question on Traveling to Uttarakuru and Other Places
mil3.7.9:1.2: “Venerable Nāgasena, is thereanybody who, with this mortal body, could go to Uttarakuru or to the Brahmaworld or to another continent?”

mil3.7.9:2.1: “How, venerable Nāgasena, could one, with this body composed of the four great elements, go to Uttarakuru or to the Brahma world or to another continent?"
mil3.7.9:2.2: “Your majesty, have you had the directexperience of jumping a hand span or a cubit on this earth?”
mil3.7.9:2.3: “Yes, venerable sir, I have had that direct experience,in fact I jump even eight cubits.”
mil3.7.9:2.4: “How, your majesty, do you jump even eight cubits?”
